name: Katori Rin
source: [url=/c42242]Sachikazu's[/url] younger sister who loves him very much and is always very carefree, being the moodmaker of his group of friends. She has been in love with Sachikazu ever since they were children, and wishes to get married with him. Due to this, she is very grateful for Manju-sama, who is finally making her wish come true: to be together forever with her onii-chan!
